ConvertFilterPolicy.AlertMessage: 1.用户需有发货组织下销售出库单的新增权限 2.销售订单“已审核”、“未关闭”、“未业务关闭”、“未冻结”、“未终止”才能进行下推 3.销售订单“可出数量（销售基本）”必须大于零才能下推 4.通过预收控制出库，需要预收的实收金额之和等于应收金额之和才能下推 5.退货订单时，退补类型为“补货”才能下推 6.物料在目标组织下允许销售、允许库存才能下推 7.变更标志非“变更中”、“取消” 的变更行才能下推 8.单据业务流程字段所采用的流程上源单与下推目标单有直接流转关系或是自由流程（业务流程字段为空） 9.发货需检验物料请走检验路线 10.销售订单勾选“生成分销采购订单”参数，需要先生成已审核的采购订单，才允许下推出库
ConvertFilterPolicy.CustFilter: ( exists ( select 1 from T_SAL_ORDERENTRY OE left join T_SAL_ORDERENTRY_F OEF on OEF.FENTRYID=OE.FENTRYID left join t_sal_order o on OE.FID=o.FID left join T_SAL_ORDERFIN fin on fin.FID=o.FID LEFT JOIN T_BD_RECCONDITION TBR ON fin.FRECCONDITIONID=TBR.FID where o.FDOCUMENTSTATUS = 'C' and OEF.FISFREE='1' and TBR.FRECMETHOD='3' and OE.FENTRYID=t2.FENTRYID) OR exists ( select 1 from t_sal_orderPlan c where c.FControlSend='OUTSTOCK' and c.FISOUTSTOCKBYRECAMOUNT='1' and c.FID=t0.FID union all select 1 from t_sal_orderPlan a inner join (select sum(FRECADVANCEAMOUNT) as FRecAdvanceAmount,sum(FRecAmount) as FRecAmount,FID from t_sal_OrderPlan where FControlSend='OUTSTOCK' group by FID) b on a.FID=b.FID where b.Frecadvanceamount=b.FRecAmount and a.FISOUTSTOCKBYRECAMOUNT='0' and a.FID=t0.FID union all select 1 from t_sal_orderPlan c where c.FControlSend<>'OUTSTOCK' and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_sal_orderPlan P WHERE P.FCONTROLSEND='OUTSTOCK' AND P.FID=c.FID) and c.FID=t0.FID) )
ConvertFilterPolicy.CustFilterDesc: 通过预收控制出库，需要预收的实收金额之和等于应收金额之和才能下推
ConvertFilterPolicy.Name: 选单条件策略

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: NOT (FMaterialID <> null and len(filter(lambda x:x.IsEnable==true and x.InvPtyId_Id==10003, FMaterialID.MaterialInvPty))>0)
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 物料没启用bom
FormBusinessService.Description: 物料没启用bom，清空bom编号
基本单位应发数量=库存基本数量

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 销售单位和库存辅单位是固定换算
FormBusinessService.Description: 销售单位和库存辅单位是固定换算：根据销售基本数量计算库存辅单位数量

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 销售单位和库存辅单位是浮动换算
FormBusinessService.Description: 销售单位和库存辅单位是浮动换算：根据库存基本数量计算库存辅单位数量
拣货后单位换算其他相关单位的数量（以库存基本数量为准）

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: FSRCBIZUNITID <> null AND FSalBaseNum > 0 AND FStockBaseDen > 0
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 携带单位不为空 且 分子、分母>0
FormBusinessService.Description: 拣货后重新计算销售基本数量=库存基本数量*销售基本分子/库存基本分母

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: FSRCBIZUNITID <> null AND FSalBaseNum > 0 AND FStockBaseDen > 0
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 携带主单位不为空 且 分子、分母>0
FormBusinessService.Description: 拣货后根据重算的销售基本数量 换算 销售数量

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 计价单位不为空 且 销售单位与计价单位是固定换算
FormBusinessService.Description: 根据销售数量换算计价数量（销售单位与计价单位是固定换算）

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 销售单位与计价单位不是固定换算
FormBusinessService.Description: 根据库存数量换算计价数量（销售单位与计价单位是浮动换算）

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 销售单位与计价单位是固定换算时
FormBusinessService.Description: 减少精度误差修正运算计价基本数量=销售基本数量 （销售单位与计价单位是固定换算时）

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: FLotPickFlag <> 4 AND FLotPickFlag <> 5 AND FExtAuxUnitId <> null AND GETCONVERTTYPE ( FMaterialId , FSalUnitId , FExtAuxUnitId ) =0
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 未正常批号拣货 且 辅助单位不为空 且 销售单位与辅助单位是固定换算
FormBusinessService.Description: 根据销售单位数量换算辅助单位数量（未批拣 且 销售单位与辅助单位是固定换算）

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: FLotPickFlag <> 4 AND FLotPickFlag <> 5 AND FExtAuxUnitId <> null AND GETCONVERTTYPE ( FMaterialId , FPriceUnitId ,FExtAuxUnitId ) =0
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 未批拣 且 辅助单位不为空 且 计价单位与辅助单位是固定换算
FormBusinessService.Description: 根据计价单位数量换算辅助单位数量（未批拣 且 计价单位与辅助单位是固定换算）

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: (FLotPickFlag <> 4 AND FLotPickFlag <> 5) AND ((GETCONVERTTYPE(FMaterialId ,FSalUnitId , FExtAuxUnitId )<>0 AND GETCONVERTTYPE ( FMaterialId ,FPriceUnitId , FExtAuxUnitId ) <>0) OR (FMaterialId.FUnitConvertDir = '1' AND GETCONVERTTYPE (FMaterialId ,FSalUnitId , FExtAuxUnitId) <>0 and GETCONVERTTYPE (FMaterialId ,FPriceUnitId ,FExtAuxUnitId)<>0 ))
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: [未批拣 且((销售与辅单位浮动 and 计价与辅单位浮动）或(换算方向是 库存-》辅助 And 辅单位与销售浮动 And 辅单位与计价浮动))]
FormBusinessService.Description: 根据库存数量换算辅单位数量[未批拣 且((销售与辅单位浮动 and 计价与辅单位浮动）或(换算方向是 库存-》辅助 And 辅单位与销售浮动 And 辅单位与计价浮动))]

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 库存辅单位数量<>0且辅助数量=0
FormBusinessService.Description: 库存辅单位数量<>0且辅助数量=0：根据库存辅单位数量计算辅助数量
计算未关联应收数量

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=false
FormBusinessService.Description: （是否含税=false）折扣额=数量*单价*折扣率

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: （是否含税=true）折扣额=数量*含税单价*折扣率

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=false且数量不为0
FormBusinessService.Description: （是否含税=false且数量不为0）净价=单价-折扣额/数量

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=true且数量不为0
FormBusinessService.Description: （是否含税=true且数量不为0）净价=含税单价-折扣额/数量

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=false，价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: （是否含税=false，价外税=true）金额=单价*数量-折扣额

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=true，价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: （是否含税=true，价外税=true）金额=(含税单价*数量-折扣额)/(1+税率)

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: FTaxCombination = null AND FIsIncludedTax=false AND FIsPriceExcludeTax = true
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 税组合为空，是否含税=false，价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: （税组合为空，是否含税=false，价外税=true）税额=(单价*数量-折扣额)*税率

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: FTaxCombination = null AND FIsIncludedTax = true AND FIsPriceExcludeTax = true
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 税组合为空，是否含税=true，价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: （税组合为空，是否含税=true，价外税=true）税额=(含税单价*数量-折扣额)/(1+税率)*税率

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: FTaxCombination = null AND FIsIncludedTax = true AND FIsPriceExcludeTax = false
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 税组合为空，是否含税=true，价外税=false
FormBusinessService.Description: （税组合为空，是否含税=true，价外税=false）税额=（含税单价*计价数量-折扣额）*税率

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: 价外税=true时，价税合计=金额+税额

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 价外税=false
FormBusinessService.Description: 价外税=false时，价税合计=含税单价*计价数量-折扣额

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=true，价外税=false
FormBusinessService.Description: （是否含税=true，价外税=false）金额=价税合计-税额

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: BILLTYPEPARAMNEW("FBillTypeID","AllAmountIsByTaxPrice","SAL_OSBillTypeParaSetting") = true AND FIsPriceExcludeTax = true AND FIsIncludedTax = true
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 单据类型参数“价税合计=数量*含税单价”=true 且价外税=true 且含税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: (尾差处理&价外税&含税)价税合计=净价*计价数量

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: BILLTYPEPARAMNEW("FBillTypeID","AllAmountIsByTaxPrice","SAL_OSBillTypeParaSetting") = true AND FIsPriceExcludeTax = true AND FIsIncludedTax = false
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 单据类型参数“价税合计=数量*含税单价”=true 且价外税=true 且含税=false
FormBusinessService.Description: (尾差处理&价外税&不含税)价税合计=净价*(1+税率%)*计价数量

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 单据类型参数“价税合计=数量*含税单价”=true 且价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: (尾差处理&价外税)税额=价税合计-金额
金额（本位币）=金额*汇率（原币与本位币的汇率）
税额（本位币）=税额*汇率（原币与本位币的汇率）
价税合计（本位币）= 税额(本位币)+金额(本位币)

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 单据类型参数“价税合计=数量*含税单价”=true 且价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: (尾差处理) 价税合计（本位币） = 价税合计* 汇率

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 单据类型参数“价税合计=数量*含税单价”=true 且价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Description: (尾差处理)税额（本位币） = 价税合计（本位币） - 金额（本位币）
订单单号=源单单号（可能合并下推）

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 保管者为空
FormBusinessService.Description: （保管者为空）保管者=表头发货组织

FormBusinessService.PreCondition: FStockID = null AND FStockLocID =null AND FRowType <> 'Parent'
FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 仓库为空时（拣货未匹配时）且 仓位为空时 且 非套件父项
FormBusinessService.Description: 仓库为空时（拣货未匹配时）且 仓位为空时默认值：仓位=物料.仓位

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 仓库为空时 且 非条件父项
FormBusinessService.Description: 仓库为空时默认值：仓库=物料.仓库
表头价税合计合计=sum(单据体价税合计)
表头价税合计（本位币）合计=sum（单据体价税合计（本位币））
表头金额合计=sum（单据体金额）
表头金额（本位币）合计=sum（单据体金额（本位币））
表头税额合计=sum（单据体税额）
表头税额（本位币）合计=sum（单据体税额（本位币））
选单清空 价目表
选单清空 折扣表

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=true且价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Parameters: ["FAllAmountExceptDisCount = round(FPriceUnitQty * FTaxPrice / ( 1 + FEntryTaxRate/ 100), FSettleCurrID.FAMOUNTDIGITS) +round(FPriceUnitQty * FTaxPrice /(1+ FEntryTaxRate/ 100) * FEntryTaxRate/ 100 , FSettleCurrID.FAMOUNTDIGITS)"]
FormBusinessService.Description: 是否含税=true且价外税=true,价税合计（折前）=计价数量*含税单价/(1+税率)+[计价数量*含税单价/(1+税率)]*税率

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=false且价外税=true
FormBusinessService.Parameters: ["FAllAmountExceptDisCount = round(FPriceUnitQty * FPrice, FSettleCurrID.FAMOUNTDIGITS) + round(FPriceUnitQty * FPrice * FEntryTaxRate / 100 , FSettleCurrID.FAMOUNTDIGITS)"]
FormBusinessService.Description: 是否含税=false,价税合计（折前）=计价数量*单价+计价数量*单价*税率

FormBusinessService.PreConditionDesc: 是否含税=true且价外税=false
FormBusinessService.Description: 是否含税=true且价外税=false,价税合计（折前）=计价数量*含税单价
